problem.title: Minimum Operations to Equalize Prefix Sums
problem.problemStatement: Given two arrays of equal length, determine the minimum number of increment operations required so that the prefix sum at every index of the first array is at least the corresponding prefix sum of the second array. In one operation, you may increase any element of the first array by 1.
problem.input: • First line contains N. • Second line contains N integers representing the first array. • Third line contains N integers representing the second array.
problem.output: • Print the minimum number of operations.
